data.script: const code = pm.iterationData.get('expected_code'); const msg = pm.iterationData.get('expected_message'); let b = {}; try { b = pm.response.json(); } catch (x) {} const issue = (b.issue && b.issue[0]) || {}; const text = (issue.details && issue.details.text) || (b.errors && b.errors[0] && b.errors[0].message) || ''; if (code) { pm.test('issue.code == ' + code, () => pm.expect(issue.code).to.eql(code)); } if (msg) { pm.test('thông điệp chứa: ' + msg, () => pm.expect(text).to.include(msg)); }

const g = k => pm.iterationData.get(k); const b = pm.response.json(); const n = (b.entry || []).length; const has = k => g(k) !== undefined && g(k) !== ''; if (has('expected_entries')) { pm.test('số entry == ' + g('expected_entries'), () => pm.expect(n).to.eql(Number(g('expected_entries')))); } if (has('expected_total')) { pm.test('total == ' + g('expected_total'), () => pm.expect(b.total).to.eql(Number(g('expected_total')))); } const rel = r => (b.link || []).some(l => l.relation === r); if (has('expected_next')) { pm.test('link next == ' + g('expected_next'), () => pm.expect(rel('next')).to.eql(g('expected_next') === 'true')); } if (has('expected_prev')) { pm.test('link previous == ' + g('expected_prev'), () => pm.expect(rel('previous')).to.eql(g('expected_prev') === 'true')); } if (has('expected_first_birthdate')) { pm.test('entry[0].birthDate == ' + g('expected_first_birthdate'), () => pm.expect(b.entry[0].resource.birthDate).to.eql(g('expected_first_birthdate'))); }
